Grupo FIT Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Você é um(a) líder que acelera com visão estratégica, paixão por gente e foco total em performance? No Grupo FIT, o(a) Diretor(a) é o nosso(a) piloto principal na pista, a liderança máxima da operação. É quem garante que as engrenagens rodem com excelência — da gastronomia à cultura, das vendas aos resultados. Com presença ativa nos boxes e olhar atento ao painel de controle, esse(a) profissional comanda múltiplas lojas e marcas, equilibrando agilidade, disciplina e visão de dono. Aqui, liderar é acelerar junto com o time, fazer pit stops estratégicos e manter o motor da operação rodando com alta performance. Se você quer estar no grid de largada de um time que valoriza gente, entrega e atitude, essa vaga é pra você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Diretor de Vendas no Grupo FIT, você terá uma atuação estratégica e multifacetada, garantindo a excelência em todas as pontas da nossa operação. Suas principais responsabilidades e atribuições incluem :

Visão Estratégica e Gestão do Negócio

Liderar operações com múltiplas marcas, formatos e perfis de loja.

Traduzir a estratégia do Grupo FIT em rotinas práticas e metas objetivas.

Apresentar resultados à diretoria com visão analítica, atitude consultiva e foco em escala.

Conduzir análises de DRE, planejamento financeiro e planos de expansão.

Testar e implementar novos formatos operacionais, com foco em crescimento sustentável.

Controle Financeiro e Resultados

Ser responsável direto por DRE, CMV, CMO, headcount e margem operacional das lojas.

Atuar sobre indicadores como produtividade, jornada, ticket médio e custo de mão de obra.

Liderar planos de recuperação de lojas com baixo desempenho.

Transformar KPIs em ações práticas de curto, médio e longo prazo.

Gestão de Pessoas Cultura

Liderar gerentes e líderes operacionais com protagonismo, escuta e foco em desenvolvimento.

Realizar feedbacks, avaliações de desempenho, planos de ação e sucessão.

Sustentar a cultura FIT na prática diária, sendo referência de atitude, disciplina e coerência.

Atuar junto ao time de Gente & Gestão em clima, engajamento e gestão de talentos.

Acompanhar indicadores de turnover, absenteísmo e clima, com planos preventivos.

Excelência Operacional

Estar presente nas unidades, conduzindo rituais de rotina, checklists e acompanhamentos.

Garantir padrões de limpeza, organização e segurança alimentar (conforme ANVISA e auditorias).

Criar e sustentar rotinas sólidas de abertura, acompanhamento e fechamento.

Controlar estoques, validade e perdas com foco em eficiência operacional e CMV saudável.

Gastronomia, Qualidade e Padrão

Atuar em conjunto com líderes de cozinha, nutricionistas e chefs.

Garantir padrão técnico e sensorial : sabor, montagem, tempo e temperatura.

Apoiar testes e lançamentos de cardápio com visão comercial e foco no cliente.

Vendas, Cliente e Marketing

Liderar times com foco em vendas, ticket médio e metas de atendimento.

Trabalhar junto ao marketing em campanhas e ativações locais.

Monitorar NPS, avaliações online e feedbacks de clientes — agindo com rapidez e inteligência.

Ser referência de postura no salão, especialmente em momentos de pico.

Relação com a Diretoria

Manter relacionamento direto com diretores e VP de Vendas, conciliando visões com foco em resultado.

Ser ponte entre o time operacional e a liderança corporativa.

Promover clareza, alinhamento e foco coletivo, sustentando a cultura de dono em todas as camadas.

Relacionamento com Concessionária (Aeroporto)

Manter relacionamento estratégico com a administração do aeroporto, garantindo conformidade com normas e excelência operacional no ambiente aeroportuário.

Análise e Planejamento

Analisar resultados, mapear processos e propor melhorias contínuas.

Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação e projetos de otimização de resultados.

Participar ativamente de reuniões com a diretoria, promovendo alinhamento estratégico e decisões ágeis.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos um profissional com o seguinte perfil e qualificações :

Organizacionais : Disciplina que nos fortalece, Segurança em cada atitude, Gratidão que nos conecta, Vibração que inspira.

Habilidades : Gostar de estar em campo, liderar com presença e transformar desafios em ação. Entender que resultado é reflexo de ritmo, cultura e consistência operacional.

Comportamentais : Comunicação clara e inteligência emocional.

Conhecimentos : Domínio de indicadores financeiros, gestão de pessoas e execução estratégica.

Certificações / Cursos Desejáveis : Formação ou cursos em gestão de negócios, gastronomia, hospitalidade ou áreas correlatas são um diferencial.

Experiência Desejável : Trajetória sólida em operações de varejo, foodservice, hospitalidade ou franquias multiloja.

Local de Atuação : Rio de Janeiro

Salário : R$ 10.000,00

Benefícios : Refeição no local + bônus de performance estratégica.

description:
Overview

A Share People hub , em parceria com o Instituto de Clima e Sociedade (ICS ), busca por Pessoa Diretora de Parcerias Institucionais e Captação , para atuação global, com sede fixa em um dos hubs: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou Brasília .

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a área de Parcerias Institucionais e Captação, assegurando a representação institucional do ICS, bem como um processo eficiente de captação de recursos e prestação de contas, além de uma receita financeira robusta e sustentável do ICS, coordenando a relação com financiadores, incluindo recursos filantrópicos, de fundos climáticos internacionais, de fontes de programas bilaterais e de cooperação ao desenvolvimento, de fontes privadas, entre outras.
  • Definir, coordenar e implementar estratégias de captação e relacionamento com financiadores, doadores e parceiros estratégicos, incluindo recursos filantrópicos, fundos climáticos internacionais, programas bilaterais, cooperação ao desenvolvimento e fontes privadas, além de identificar e desenvolver novas parcerias.
  • Manter relações e coordenação contínua com financiadores do ICS e outras parceiras estratégicas (tais como instituições similares ao ICS operando em outros países), incluindo gerenciar a coordenação de intercâmbio de informações, conhecimento e diálogo, considerando tendências e necessidades de doadores.
  • Supervisionar a preparação de novas propostas, renovações de apoios e relatórios, garantindo elevada qualidade de textos e documentos apresentados a financiadores.
  • Prospectar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de captação de recursos para o ICS (incluindo recursos filantrópicos, fundos climáticos internacionais, programas bilaterais e de cooperação ao desenvolvimento, fontes privadas, entre outras) e desenvolver estratégias para captar e executar tais recursos, contemplando a identificação de arranjos institucionais, potenciais parcerias estratégicas para sua implementação, bem como a elaboração de recomendações e propostas sobre novas formas de captação e execução.
  • Monitorar tendências, prioridades e linhas de financiamento de diferentes fontes, assegurando desenvolvimento constante de recomendações sobre potenciais áreas estratégicas e possíveis considerações operacionais para o ICS.
  • Aprimorar os processos internos de gestão de informação para subsidiar a preparação de propostas e relatórios.
  • Representar a organização em fóruns, eventos e agendas com financiadores, parceiros e iniciativas de cooperação internacional.
  • Co-construir com o departamento programático projetos e narrativas de captação de recursos que respondam às prioridades da organização.
  • Participar ativamente do Grupo Gestor e contribuir para a gestão geral do Instituto.
  • Coordenar as equipes por meio das melhores práticas de gestão de pessoas.

Requisitos

  • Curso superior completo, preferencialmente em Direito, Administração, Ciências Econômicas;
  • Inglês fluente, espanhol será diferencial complementar;
  • Experiência mínima de 12 anos em cargos correlatos de liderança na captação de recursos, em particular relacionados a mudanças do clima, seja no terceiro setor, em agência de cooperação ou em filantropias;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas e processos;
  • Experiência comprovada em preparação de propostas para financiamento, gestão e relação com doadores e financiadores, gestão de parcerias, relatórios e gestão de fundos;
  • Conhecimento profundo de requerimentos, critérios, indicadores e linha vertical de fundos climáticos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais, conforme demanda.
  • Desejável conhecimento com gestão de monitoramento e regranting;

Sobre o ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Priorizamos medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, especialmente para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é doar para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

title: Regulatory Affairs (Pharma) Expert
description:
Overview

At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our Values

Our values guide how we work:

  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation

Responsibilities

Your Responsibilities:

  • Lead global regulatory strategy and submissions across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
  • Plan, author, and review eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
  • Represent Regulatory Affairs on cross-functional teams, providing guidance on regional requirements and development pathways
  • Provide strategic input on CMC, clinical, and nonclinical documentation for global compliance
  • Coordinate electronic submissions with Regulatory Operations using Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart, and global gateways (FDA ESG, CESP, BfArM, Health Canada, ANVISA)
  • Monitor global regulations and communicate key changes to stakeholders
  • Prepare regulatory correspondence, briefing packages, and materials for health authority meetings
  • Manage post-approval commitments, renewals, and lifecycle activities
  • Review labeling, advertising, and promotional materials for regulatory compliance
  • Maintain relationships with health authorities and industry peers
  • Partner with Quality, Clinical, Nonclinical, and Manufacturing to align regulatory documentation
  • Improve regulatory processes and support audits, inspections, and other regulatory projects

Your Profile

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or related field required; advanced degree (M.S., Ph.D., Pharm.D.) preferred
  • RAC certification or equivalent highly desirable; ongoing professional development in global regulatory strategy is a plus
  • 8–10 years of global regulatory affairs experience in drug development and lifecycle management across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
  • Strong hands-on experience with global eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
  • Proven success in global registration strategy and interactions with FDA, EMA, Health Canada, ANVISA, NMPA, and other authorities
  • Deep knowledge of ICH guidelines, regional regulations, and global submission standards
  • Proficiency with regulatory information/publishing systems (e.g., Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart) and electronic gateways
  • Broad understanding of CMC, clinical, and nonclinical regulatory requirements
  • Strong project management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a global matrix, handle multiple complex projects, and adapt to evolving regulatory requirements

Our Offer for you

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.

  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

The Petroleum Economics Principal Analyst, Latin America functions as a member of the Vantage Asset Valuation team, providing expert fiscal, economic and financial analysis of upstream assets in Latin America for a wide-ranging customer base. You will become a subject matter expert on oil and gas fiscal modelling, working alongside a global team of experienced researchers and engineers. You will build your knowledge around the wider upstream industry as it, and S&P Global, adapts and evolves with the energy expansion. You'll be a key contact for fiscal research and economic modelling in your region for both internal and external customers.

The Team

CERA Upstream Solutions at S&P Global Energy comprises some of the most extensive and complete information, analytics, insight, and advisory services in the world. We deliver oil and gas databases and software, energy transition, energy supply and demand forecasts, and comprehensive data on transactions at the global and regional market levels.

Responsibilities and Impact

  • Be the go-to individual for fiscal research and economic analysis with thought-provoking, qualitative and quantitative deliverables in the form of Excel-based models, written reports and presentations. Ensure that the breadth of coverage of Vantage fiscal models covers all types of locations and properties.
  • Develop stand-alone project-level as well as portfolio- and company-level consolidated cash flow models.
  • Respond to customer questions of various complexity in assigned geographical regions by providing deep subject matter expertise, timely insight, and good judgement.
  • Work in close cooperation with colleagues in publishing exciting and timely content.
  • Collaborate with product management teams to help define what type of results and analysis customers want to see and contribute to the continual development of the Vantage product and its relevant functionality.
  • Provide expert support to commercial teams, management, and colleagues for the marketing of the Vantage product to contribute to securing and retaining customers.
  • Continuously develop expertise in a particular practice or focus area and expand knowledge into related fields. Stay abreast of current topics and contribute to written/published products to broaden and build upon subject matter knowledge.

What We’re Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications

  • At least a bachelor’s degree or studies towards a chartered qualification in economics, finance, tax, accounting or law is a must. An equivalent combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Hands-on experience of constructing, modifying, and reviewing Excel-based DCF models (including key financial metrics), ideally of oil and gas upstream and midstream assets.
  • Experience with / ability to extract fiscal, financial and economic / commercial information from contracts, legislation, etc. and quantify it in the economic models; knowledge of oil and gas upstream fiscal terms / contracts and broader petroleum economics.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

title: Process Engineer - Sulfur Recovery-Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Overview

We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands-on expertise in Sulfur Recovery Unit (SRU) and Sour Water Stripper (SWS) processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD).

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

Your primary role is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for refineries' SRU & SWS, including remote and on-site technical advisory support, benchmarking, and technology knowledge management.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct regular performance reviews of existing SRU & SWS facilities and analyze KPIs related to operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
  • Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps.
  • Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities, facilitating knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and distribute bi-monthly SRU & SWS technical best practices bulletins, ensuring knowledge dissemination across Global Manufacturing facilities.
  • Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including troubleshooting, start-up/shutdown activities, capacity test runs, and technology pilot testing and provide detailed service reports for each support activity.
  • Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization and process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low-hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment.
  • Conduct internal assessments of SRU & SWS process engineering standards, ensuring alignment with Saudi Aramco engineering standards and supporting their implementation across Global Manufacturing facilities.
  • Participate in Business Plan development, coordinating with stakeholders on capital investments for SRU & SWS units and supporting techno-economic evaluations.
  • Evaluate and recommend new SRU & SWS technologies and coordinate with relevant departments for assessment and piloting support.
  • Actively participate in external benchmarking activities with industry bodies such as Japan Cooperation Council Petroleum (JCCP) and Gulf Downstream Association (GDA).
  • You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • A minimum of 15 years of total refinery or gas plants process units experience, with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in handling SRUs/TGTU/SWS plants.
  • You will be able to optimize SRU & SWS operations, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
  • You will have in-depth knowledge of SRU/TGTU process licensor technologies.
  • You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start-up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for SRU & SWS units.
  • You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to SRU & SWS performance metrics.
  • You will have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management
  • You will also have excellent computer and presentation skills.

Regime CLT, remuneração inicial de R$ 55,03 a R$ 124,78 por hora em sala de aula conforme modalidade, titulação e experiência acadêmica, além de adicionais diversos. Plano de carreira até R$ 124,78 por hora em sala de aula, incluindo adicional de aprimoramento de 5 % para mestrado e 10 % para doutorado. Descanso semanal remunerado, isto é, 1/6 adicional sobre os valores acima informados. Férias coletivas remuneradas de 30 dias por ano, 13º salário, FGTS e INSS e vale transporte opcional. title: Petroleum Economics Principal Analyst, Latin America
description:
About the Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 10

The Petroleum Economics Principal Analyst, Latin America functions as a member of the Vantage Asset Valuation team, providing expert fiscal, economic and financial analysis of upstream assets in Latin America for a wide-ranging customer base. You will become a subject matter expert on oil and gas fiscal modelling, working alongside a global team of experienced researchers and engineers. You will build your knowledge around the wider upstream industry as it, and S&P Global, adapts and evolves with the energy expansion. You'll be a key contact for fiscal research and economic modelling in your region for both internal and external customers.

The Team

CERA Upstream Solutions at S&P Global Energy comprise some of the most extensive and complete information, analytics, insight, and advisory services in the world. We deliver oil and gas databases and software, energy transition, energy supply and demand forecasts, and comprehensive data on transactions at the global and regional market levels.

Responsibilities and Impact

  • Be the go-to individual for fiscal research and economic analysis with thought-provoking, qualitative and quantitative deliverables in the form of excel based models, written reports and presentations. Ensure that the breadth of coverage of Vantage fiscal models covers all types of locations and properties.
  • Develop stand-alone project level as well as portfolio and company level consolidated cash flow models.
  • Respond to customer questions of various complexity in assigned geographical regions by providing deep subject matter expertise, timely insight, and good judgement.
  • Work in close co-operation with colleagues in publishing exciting and timely content.
  • Collaborate with product management teams to help define what type of results and analysis customers want to see and contribute to the continual development of the Vantage product and its relevant functionality.
  • Provide expert support to commercial teams, management, and colleagues for the marketing of the Vantage product to contribute to securing and retaining customers.
  • Continuously develop expertise in a particular practice or focus area and expand knowledge into related fields. Stay abreast of current/hot topics and contribute to written/published products to broaden and build upon subject matter knowledge.

What We’re Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications:

  • At least a bachelor’s degree or studies towards a chartered qualification in economics, finance, tax, accountancy or law is a must. An equivalent combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Hands-on experience of constructing, modifying, and reviewing Excel based DCF models (including key financial metrics), ideally of oil and gas upstream and midstream assets.
  • Experience with / ability to extract fiscal, financial and economic / commercial information from contracts, legislation, etc. and quantify it in the economic models; knowledge of oil and gas upstream fiscal terms / contracts and broader petroleum economics.
  • Native/Fluent Portuguese Speaker

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Expert level proficiency in Excel.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in functional programming (preferably F#), applying best practices, and producing clean, unit-tested, maintainable code in a collaborative production environment.
  • Data analytics tools such as SQL, python, R, or other programming languages knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience in a similar role and with an oil and gas operator, reserves auditor, consulting, advisory or financial institution.

Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
About the Role


The Service Provider will be providing QC services at WAG (Water Alternate Gas) manifolds worksite based in Rio, Brazil with frequent travel within to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG Brasil. You will be responsible to ensure that Contractor (CTR) supplies WAG Manifold and Foundations on-time as per the clients HSE policies and with satisfactory & required level of quality.


The Service Provider will liaise with CPY Subsea HSE Lead, CPY Quality Lead, CPY Materials & Welding Lead and CPY Delivery Lead.



HSE and Compliance



  • Fully comply with site security, health and safety instructions, stay vigilant and maintain continuous awareness of hazards and surroundings.

  • Will be accountable for demonstrating, individually, an exemplary behaviour regarding HSE rules & requirements, including trainings, and enforcing HSE execution decisions/directions taken by CPY Subsea HSE Lead.

  • Report any issue/anomalies (using system in place in the facility) and to make use of TOTAL STOP WORK policy as necessary.

  • Ensure that risk assessments are performed as and when necessary, that management of change is adhered to and that tool-box talks are conducted efficiently.

  • Adopt and demonstrate exemplary behaviour regarding Company Ethics and “Code of Conduct” policy and promote the re-enforcement of the Anti-Corruption Program.


WORK TASKS


The Service holder will be responsible to control that the work performed by CTR and sub-CTR is in line with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations in terms of Quality.


For all these tasks, the incumbent will be requested:



  • To conduct thorough inspections of welds and welding processes to ensure compliance with applicable WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and specifications, have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have extensive inspection knowledge and experience (min 10 years) in CRA materials such as Super duplex (Pipe/Forging and HIPPED), Inconel 625 and LAS (F22)

  • To have excellent inspection experience in buttering, overlay and girth welding of Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables

  • To utilize advanced inspection techniques including visual, ultrasonic, Phase Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT), magnetic particle, Liquid penetrant Inspection and radiographic testing to assess weld quality as per ASME/DNV code requirements

  • To have ability to interpret welding procedure specifications (WPS) and procedure qualification records (PQR) to validate conformance at site during production

  • To have the ability to perform inspection on incoming production materials against requirements and mill certificates

  • To participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and development of corrective action plans in collaboration with project welding engineer and site production teams

  • To identify and raise subsequent comments highlight deviations, unacceptable or unjustified quality issues related but not limited to Welding that could affect SPS equipment during fabrication, installation, and production at site

  • To prepare detailed inspection reports and documentation for compliance on weekly basis

  • To collaborate with Company Site Rep and CPY material engineer on any welding/NDT/material issues at site

  • To stop the work in case of non-conformity and re-assess the situation before resuming To discuss with contractor/sub-contractors in case of issues/unconformity during the control program, to look for acceptable solutions in order not to penalize the delivery schedule but still fulfilling the quality standards set by the contract

  • To ensure that unconformities are driven towards closure in a timely manner (i.e. without impacting the delivery schedule)

  • To follow up site welding activities and provide feedback to project team

  • To participate to COMPANY and contractor audits and follow up closure of identified issues


About You


You are a highly experienced welding and quality professional with a strong background in subsea structures and WAG manifolds. You bring more than 15 years of hands-on experience in welding inspection, with deep technical knowledge of welding processes, materials, and offshore fabrication requirements.


You hold a recognized Welding Inspector certification such as CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2 (or equivalent) and are certified to Level 3 in multiple Non-Destructive Testing methods, including Ultrasonic Testing (UT/PAUT), Radiography (RT), and Dye Penetrant Inspection (DPI).


You are confident in interpreting complex engineering drawings, technical specifications, and welding documentation, and you are known for your strong analytical skills and ability to investigate root causes and resolve challenging quality issues in fast-paced project environments.


You communicate clearly and professionally in English, with additional language skills in Portuguese or French considered an advantage.

description:
Overview

The Global Customer Operations (GCO) Associate role is in a 24x7x365 office environment. This individual will be working in an operations environment taking inbound calls and requests from SES customers requesting to access SES satellites as well as requests to peak and pol customer antennas. This work requires specific knowledge of radio frequency (RF) technology and Intelsat's satellite network in order to provide the needed level of service to our customers. Associates will receive initial training in order to perform the role, but a general understanding of RF technology and a technical acumen is required.

This team member will manage and maintain incoming customer requests and work closely with internal teams to ensure customer needs and external service levels are met. The GCO Associate’s role is focused on supporting the SES customer base. This role also requires a candidate with written and verbal fluency in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

What you will do

  • Support customer calls and requests in English, Spanish and Portuguese
  • Able to successfully learn and navigate Web based applications and tools for use in managing customer accounts. This will include Peak and Poles OU Accesses and services for customers within established service level norms; which includes verification of network connectivity and confirmation of network interference.
  • Stay up to date on new technology, tools and applications that are used to provide the assistance needed for customer requests
  • Must exhibit sense of urgency to complete customer requests in a timely manner and engage internal support teams to take over troubleshooting in the event of a customer impacting issue
  • Ensure compliance with SESstandards practices and processes
  • Incorporate and leverage industry best practices while maintaining alignment with SESgoals and capabilities
  • Must be able to maintain customer privacy in compliance with all applicable laws
  • Able to successfully navigate and use Microsoft Office Suite products
  • Manage positive relationships with customers to ensure customer retention
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Must be able to meet set expectations for call center metrics and customer turnaround times
  • Escalate customer reported technical service issues or requests to the appropriate NOC vertical team
  • Maintain accurate information and data in appropriate systems by tracking and capturing information and data
  • Ability to operate in a team environment cross functionally where employees constantly provide support to each other
  • Flexible and adaptive to change

Your required experience/skills

  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • One year of satellite communications experience including an understanding of RF technology
  • One year of proven customer service including relevant experience or equivalent education experience
  • High aptitude for Networking and troubleshooting
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Possess problem analysis and problem resolution skills

Your success in this role will look like:

  • Meet or exceed expectations in gathering and implementing reporting or tool requirements
  • Must be available to work rotating shifts
  • Support network operations center network engineering and sales teams by reduced reducing customer response time and minimizing impact to customers
  • Must have strong written and verbal communication
  • Must be able to work in 24/7/365 environment – includes weekends and holidays

It would be nice if you had:

  • Experience working with Network Operation Centers is a plus but not required
  • Positive attitude with an outgoing disposition

You foster a collaborative work environment that aligns with SBM Offshore’s values and goals.
  • You ensure that payroll and benefits processes comply with local and global regulations, internal policies, and audits. You keep current on labor laws, tax regulations, and benefits trends to minimize risks. You support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and reports as needed.
  • You continuously identify opportunities to streamline payroll and benefits processes using technology and best practices. You develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and reports for HR and management review. title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy.

Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location

Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing.

Leadership and Accountability

This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.

Responsibilities

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Overview

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Accreditation Client Group Manager plays a key role in the operational delivery of client group accreditation services in support of tournament operations across all venues and official facilities. Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Senior Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Manager is responsible for the day-to-day coordination, and delivery of accreditation services for assigned client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working within the established tournament accreditation framework, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, FIFA27 Accreditation teams and functional areas, the role ensures that client group accreditation requirements are delivered in line with defined FIFA accreditation policies, access control protocols, and agreed service standards. The role provides operational leadership to Client Group Coordinators and serves as the primary operational escalation point for assigned client groups.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Group Management: Act as the primary accreditation point of contact for assigned client groups (e.g. safety & security, workforce, volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners).
  • Understand and manage client group accreditation requirements, volumes, timelines, and access needs in line with the overall accreditation framework and agreed milestones.
  • Coordinate the delivery of client group accreditation activities across all planning and operational phases.
  • Monitor readiness and proactively identify delivery risks, escalating issues as required.
  • Accreditation Process Delivery: Manage the end-to-end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including data collection, validation, access rights assignment, badge production, and distribution.
  • Ensure accurate application of access rights in accordance with approved zoning concepts, access matrices, and security requirements.
  • Coordinate accreditation activities and dependencies with Accreditation Operations, Systems, Security, and Venue teams.
  • Track application progress, volumes, and bottlenecks and implement corrective actions where required.
  • Team Leadership & Support: Lead, coordinate, and support Client Group Coordinators in the delivery of day-to-day accreditation activities.
  • Provide guidance on complex cases and ensure consistent application of processes across client groups.
  • Support onboarding, training, and knowledge sharing within the client group team.
  • Promote clear task ownership, prioritisation, and accountability.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Work closely with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to support agreed accreditation requirements and timelines.
  • Communicate accreditation procedures, deadlines, and data requirements clearly and consistently to client groups.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of training sessions, briefings, and guidance materials.
  • Act as the primary operational escalation point for client group accreditation issues, escalating complex or cross-functional matters to the Client Group Senior Manager.
  • Event-Time Operations: Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points before and during the tournament.
  • Coordinate with Venue Operations, Security, and Accreditation Operations teams to resolve access-related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Provide operational decision-making support within defined authority during peak arrival and match-day phases.
  • Support on-site supervision of accreditation staff and workflows as required.
  • Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement: Ensure all client group accreditation activities comply with FIFA accreditation regulations, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Maintain accurate client group accreditation records, statistics, and issue logs.
  • Provide regular operational updates and reports to the Client Group Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reporting, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer activities.

Your Profile

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accreditation, access management, client services, or operations within major international events.
  • Strong working knowledge of accreditation systems, access control concepts, and venue zoning models.
  • Experience working in large-scale, multi-stakeholder, and multicultural event environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in high-pressure environments.
  • Clear and confident communicator with strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to identify issues early and escalate appropriately.
  • Team-oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivery and compliance.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during peak tournament phases.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands-on expertise in Utilities processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD) under Global Manufacturing (GM) Excellence Organization.

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to GM operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

Your primary is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for Utilities, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support and benchmarking of utilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct regular performance reviews of existing Utilities through key performance indicators (KPIs) representing optimum operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
  • Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
  • Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates) and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including process design, troubleshooting, start-up/shutdown activities, and capacity test runs.
  • Provide detailed service reports for each support activity, highlighting facility needs, actions taken, results, and lessons learned.
  • Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization or process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low-hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment, through operational adjustment or design modification.
  • Conduct internal assessments on Utilities using Saudi Aramco engineering standard references and highlight any deviations or better standards applied by affiliates for endorsement to facility management or Saudi Aramco Central Engineering.
  • Act as the overall coordinator for cascading and driving Global Manufacturing and Corporate programs for Utilities in operating facilities, enabling their execution and effective monitoring.
  • Participate in Business Plan development, coordinate with stakeholders for capital investments on assigned Utilities and support techno-economic evaluations.
  • Evaluate and recommend new Utilities technologies, coordinate with Central Engineering to facilitate field deployment.

Qualifications

  • You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of total Utilities unit experience (process engineering and operations) with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in handling refinery’s utilities.
  • You will have experience in water desalination and boilers for steam generation
  • You will be able to optimize various utility systems, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
  • You will have in-depth knowledge of major equipment suppliers and package units for Utilities.
  • You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start-up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for utility systems.
  • You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Utilities performance metrics.
  • You will also have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management.

People and Culture at Nubank

Our team works on identifying, attracting, reaching out, assessing, engaging, nurturing and hiring top-notch talent that can strengthen Nubank’s culture. We’re looking for a passionate, data-driven Senior Recruiter to join our global Talent Acquisition team. You’ll play a critical role in helping us scale our product teams, identifying top-tier talent, and shaping an inclusive candidate experience across borders. You’ll work closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners to drive full-cycle recruitment strategies and bring in exceptional talent that shares our mission and values. We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. Nice To Have

Why Nubank?

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check more information here.

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

This is an opportunity for a Linux Engineer passion for Linux and Customer Success to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have a passion for technology and an eagerness to learn, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full Desktop and Server technical stack at Canonical. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers.

Your day to day job is to provide technical expertise, be an excellent communicator and a service-oriented professional. Every day you will have to make judgement calls to prioritise customer issues and maximise your effectiveness. You will also need to set time aside to learn about our new products and technologies and evolve as a professional. You will participate in various training sessions, team gatherings and Company events.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Investigate issues reported by customers by researching and escalating issues
  • Work to resolve complex customer problems related to Canonical's portfolio of products.
  • Ownership of results: Ensure that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
  • Engage directly with customers and work collaboratively by phone, ticketing system, and remote sessions to resolve their issues.
  • Participate in a regular weekend working rotation.
  • Contribute new knowledge base articles and maintain existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix.

What are we looking for in you

  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)

  • Troubleshooting experience:
    • Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.).
    • Ability to navigate effectively stack traces and logs, and advise on next steps.
    • Solid understanding of OS and Application level bugs and when to elevate to the correct team.
  • Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job
  • Programming fundamentals in any language.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • Extensive Customer support experience is key:
    • Customer needs are top priority.
    • Communicate professionally, emphatically, clearly and set the right expectations.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Monitorar a saúde da rede (LAN, WAN, Wi‑Fi, VPN, SD‑WAN);

  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes de média complexidade;
  • Diagnosticar problemas de conectividade (camadas L2, L3 e L4);
  • Analyser rotas, VLANs, NAT, ACLs, DNS e DHCP;
  • Configurar e manter VPNs (site‑to‑site, client VPN);
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de segurança (SecOps);
  • Garantir segregação de redes (VLANs, zonas de segurança);
  • Configurar ExpressRoute / Direct Connect (apoio);
  • Configurar DNS híbrido.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Conhecimento em modelos OSI e TCP/IP.
  • Noções de endereçamento IPv4/IPv6, CIDR, e subnetting.
  • Experiência em configuração e troubleshooting de redes (VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, LACP, ACLs).
  • Domínio em protocolos como ARP, ICMP, TCP, UDP e NAT.Experiência com firewalls, VPNs e Switches;
  • Conhecimento básico de QoS, roteamento estático e dinâmico, e troubleshooting de tráfego.

Será um diferencial, caso você tenha:

  • Experiência no ramo do varejo.

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Quem Somos

Quem Somos: Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito

Nosso Jeito: Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito

Valores e Propósito: Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão

Diversidade e inclusão: A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Technology Consultant to join Global Manufacturing Excellence Digitalization and Technology Division(D&TD).

Global Manufacturing Excellence is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio. D&TD is responsible for leading the technology function collaborating across various downstream functions and corporate as well.

Your primary role is to support the development and deployment of technology management programs aimed at providing technical support across Saudi Aramco Global Manufacturing portfolio. You will ideate, introduce, deploy and sustain novel and innovative technological solutions within various domains including reliability, maintenance, sustainability, energy and process.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Lead the end-to-end implementation of Technologies across the downstream portfolio including petrochemical facilities, refineries, terminals and bulk plants as well as gas plants.
  • Develop comprehensive value adding technology roadmaps aligned to business challenges such as energy optimization, sustainability, plant availability, debottlenecking and process optimization.
  • Accelerate technology deployment working closely with internal and external execution agencies and vendors.
  • Conduct feasibility studies including technical and economic evaluation of solutions, platforms, and new technologies.
  • Perform technologies scouting to enable the identification of innovative and value adding technologies.
  • Develop business case and cost/benefit analysis for technologies deployment.
  • Work with other consultants, engineers, and project managers to deliver comprehensive solutions that address both technical and business requirements.
  • Prepare reports and presentations to communicate the progress and benefits of technology initiatives to peers, relevant stakeholders and senior management.
  • Collaborate with technology providers in developing and conducting tailored training content and programs to support the implementation and adoption of technologies by end-users.
  • Recognize and introduce necessary changes to standards and governance.
  • Stay abreast of global and regional Oil and Gas industry trends, market conditions, and regulatory changes that may impact technology implementations.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance and standards, evaluate solution implementations. And identify necessary changes to standards and governance.
  • You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field (Chemical, Industrial, Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering). A Masters’ degree is preferred.
  • You will have 10-15 years of experience as a Technology Consultant ideating, scouting, introducing and tracking value added technology deployment.
  • You have good understanding of downstream technologies, including but not limited to refinery processes.
  • You will have experience in developing business case and benefit/cost analysis for downstream technology.
  • You will have experience in working collaboratively in cross-functional teams, across the project lifecycle fostering effective communication and cooperation.
  • You will be able to demonstrate excellent understanding of management of change, engineering and design package as well as regulatory, risk mitigation and safety requirements.
  • You will have experience in change management, including developing and implementing technology changes.
  • You will be able to demonstrate understanding of relevant industry energy, safety and design regulations and standards ensuring compliance of proposed technology solutions.
  • You will be able to demonstrate excellent understanding of manufacturing technology solutions enabling the key process areas including production, reliability, environmental, safety and sustainability
  • You will have strong project management skills with a proven track record of successfully leading and delivering complex technology implementation projects in the O&G business
  • You have the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Overview

The Principal Engineer will act as the Product Organisation's representative for the Brazil region and will serve as the primary point of contact for all ICM product related activities, with particular focus on Mechanically Lined Pipe products.

This role requires applying technical expertise to support the region in the advancement and promotion of Subsea7's Internal Corrosion Management products for client projects, new product development and continuous improvement initiatives.

The Principal Engineer will also manage communications and actions associated with clients and therefore must demonstrate strong collaboration and communication skills, engaging effectively with stakeholders at all organisational levels.

The role requires solid understanding of pipe manufacturing processes, pipeline fabrication and installation methods combined with significant theoretical and practical expertise in Corrosion Resistant Alloy materials and associated pipeline solutions.

Key responsibilities include providing technical and commercial product support for early engagement activities and project strategies, building and maintaining relationships with internal stakeholders, clients and suppliers, ensuring accurate technical communication, supporting product strategy definition, identifying and eliminating product cost of loss, providing support to Supply Chain Management, leading product development programmes and participating in Communities of Experts. The role will also gather and maintain regional market intelligence, regulatory updates and technological advancements relevant to ICM products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Technical and Commercial Support : Provide technical product information (including product design and operational envelopes) and commercially appropriate product recommendations and guidance to key stakeholders in support of early engagement activities and project win strategies.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration and Communications : Build and maintain relationships with key internal and external (clients and suppliers) stakeholders.

Provide clear and accurate product communications (verbally, written or via presentations), both technical and commercial, to internal audiences including senior management.

Ensure accuracy and alignment of product information across key internal stakeholders and externally with clients and suppliers.

  • Provide Input to Product Strategy: Work with the Product Director and Product Engineering Manager to ensure product roadmaps and team activities remain accurate and relevant to the region. In addition, the Principal Engineer will help maintain product trend analysis, SWOT analysis and competition analysis.
  • Eliminate Product Cost of Loss: Utilising information streams such as project feedback, Lessons Learned, product risk matrices, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), Supplier Performance Incidents (SPIs), identify and execute opportunities for product improvements and to eliminate product associated cost of loss for future projects.
  • Supply Chain Support: Provide technical support to Supply Chain Management regarding suppliers of ICM pipeline products, including market assessments, leading qualification activities and facilitating discussions around product schedule, quality, cost, etc.
  • Lead Product Development Programmes: Ensure new products are developed, and introduced to the market, in line with Company processes and product strategy. In addition, lead product portfolio expansion projects such as new material selection and qualification.
  • Community of Experts (CoE) Participation : Participate and contribute in relevant CoE meetings. Provide product input and perspective for the purpose of the development of technical standards and specifications.
  • Product Related Market Intelligence: Gather regional product associated market information to support product team strategies. Maintain awareness of regional regulatory and client specification changes and product associated technological advancements.

Skills and Experience

  • Masters Degree qualified in relevant subject (ideally Materials - Metallurgy based).
  • Thorough understanding of pipe manufacturing processes, fabrication and installation methods.
  • Significant theoretical and practical understanding of CRA materials and associated pipeline solutions (in particular Mechanically Lined Pipe).
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills at all levels of the business. Ability to create and deliver reports and presentations.
  • Effective analytical skills, applies creative problem solving, will suggest and develop new methods and ways of working.
  • A collaborative worker who builds effective relationships across a highly diverse global business.
  • Self-motivated, takes ownership of responsibilities and works with minimum supervision, while also contributing to the wider team activities.
  • Pro-active planning and organising skills, able to identify and effectively prioritise workload and successfully meet multiple, competing deadlines.
  • Flexible to adapt to changing priorities within a fast-paced 24/7 global business.
  • Progressive thinking, pro-actively seeks to develop own learning and development.
  • Committed to continuous improvement and identification of efficient work methods and processes.
  • IT proficient across MS Office.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

title: Senior Project Manager Travel
description:
Senior Project Manager Travel

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Travel Project Manager oversees strategic travel planning, commercial management, and operations within the complex environment of a multi-stakeholder tournament.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 by organizing and managing travel projects that provide safe, efficient, and dependable transportation for everyone involved in the event.

Responsible for turning FWWC27 event requirements into practical travel plans, the Senior Travel Project Manager works under tight deadlines and in collaboration with various stakeholders.

Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers.

The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones.

By using structured project management methods and competency standards, this role supports consistent outcomes, builds stakeholder trust, and delivers an exceptional tournament experience. Additionally, it contributes to knowledge sharing, ongoing improvement, and planning for future events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic, Commercial & Financial Oversight

  • Ownership of tournament travel budget planning, cost benchmarking, and financial risk mitigation
  • Market benchmarking of airline/charter pricing to ensure competitiveness (RFP)
  • Identification, analysis, and escalation of pricing inconsistencies, capacity constraints, and commercial misalignments with airline and travel partners
  • Contribution to the development of travel rate cards, pricing frameworks, and commercial guidelines

Scenario Planning & Risk Management

  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risk
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control

Senior Stakeholder & Executive Interface

  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

Data, Systems & Process Governance

  • Oversight of travel-related data accuracy, reporting structures, and decision-support tools used throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Ensuring transparency, traceability, and auditability of travel decisions, supplier selections, and cost structures
  • Contribution to the continuous improvement of FIFA travel handbooks, templates, operational playbooks, and systems

Tournament Scale & Complexity Management

  • End-to-end coordination of high-volume, multi-city charter and scheduled flight operations during tournament time
  • Ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple client groups (Teams, Delegates, Guests, VIPs, Workforce, FIFA/FWWC27 stakeholders)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management

Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation)
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules are a must
  • At least 2 years of experience in project and event management

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience in budgeting and accounting
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, additional languages beneficial
  • Practical commercial experience, distinguished geographical knowledge
  • Systemic and analytical thinking
  • Autonomy and sense of responsibility
  • Practical and process-oriented working profile with quality and efficiency
  • Intercultural competencies, Flexibility, adapting working processes to different cultures
  • Strong team player
  • Clear communication skills in different languages
  • Friendly and diplomatic behaviour to customers, team members and working colleagues
  • Capability to promote knowledge transfer with other team members
  • Service-oriented working style
  • Taking initiative and working proactively
  • Speedy delivery of short-term orders, respecting deadlines
  • Vision to predict potential problematical scenarios and anticipate solutions
  • Creativity to solve unforeseen issues
  • Solution-oriented operation

Certifications & Requirements

  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Strong GDS skills, with preference for Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules required
